flags: The official story-map cache preserves only the parade-route summary. It provides no road geometry, endpoints, length, drive time, designation date or construction campaign. The overview is shorter than the requested target and its last paragraph is a geographic itinerary, not a verified end-to-end byway alignment.

Port Koneta is retained as a short historical moment. The cache confirms its closure and Armstrong’s pilot license but does not support his bicycle trips, August 1946 date, age 16, student-certificate terminology or earning it before a driver’s license. Those current claims were dropped. No visible remains or public access are established.

Wapa Theater has no support anywhere in this cache. Its current moment was dropped, including the 1904 Brown Theater opening, 1939 neon marquee and speculative Armstrong attendance. Blume High School replaces it, with coordinates from its Wikipedia cache.
The current drugstore employment/flying-lesson funding claim, baritone-horn detail and French-soldier river-name explanation have no support in the cache and were dropped.

The strip has no moment mileages and includes uncached OSM places. Moments follow north-side airfield, downtown school and east-side museum; an editor should check that sequence against complete byway geometry. The kept Port Koneta pin is retained as required but is not independently located by a cache coordinate line.
